title: Early British millionaires
hook: Business historian Peter Scott has reconstructed a dataset of Britain’s “inter-war super-rich.” Scott started with an official (but mostly nameless) list of 438 “millionaires” (which tax authorities defined as people with annual incomes above £50,000) from 1928/29, and then cross-referenced the entries with other sources to identify 291 men and 28 women who fit the criteria.
